public_rationale: The study documents recurring failures in unselected DALL·E 3 outputs on the kinds of compositional constraints discussed in the post. Failures remain substantial when normal prompt rewriting is allowed. This supports the behavioral claim that such errors were common on these tasks. It does not establish an internal lack of understanding or an error rate for all image-generation requests.
limitations: The strongest direct evidence concerns DALL·E 3.
Suppressing prompt rewriting is not the ordinary ChatGPT workflow; the study also reports the rewritten-prompt condition.
Human agreement scores are judgments of prompt adherence, not a measurement of cognition.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Compositional and part-related errors remain common in generative AI, with default answers often reflecting a lack of full comprehension of language or the world.

statement.excerpt: But errors of these sorts remain common; default, first answers often reflect a lack of full comprehension, sometimes of language, sometimes of the world.
statement.document_title: Don’t Ride This Bike! Generative AI’s persistent trouble with compositionality and parts

from_speaker: errors of these sorts remain common

our_interpretation: Errors of these sorts means failures involving composition, relations, counts, and inclusion or omission of specified objects or parts.
Common means recurring substantial failures across systematic tests, rather than isolated examples; no exact percentage is attributed to Marcus.
Comprehension is read behaviorally as satisfying the stated constraints. The assessment does not infer an internal mental state.
Current refers to systems available by December 8, 2024. With no standard quarterly research reporting period, the observation window is the latest reporting year to date.
Initial outputs means outputs before corrective interaction or selection of the best result.
criteria.support_condition: Systematic evaluations of unselected initial outputs show substantial recurring errors on the discussed kinds of compositional constraints.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative evaluations show that such errors are rare in unselected initial outputs across those tasks.

evidence.explanation: Tests conducted from March through November used unselected generations and found human-rated matches of 45% for physical relations and 12.3% for unmodified negation prompts. Ordinary prompt rewriting improved negation matching to 40.7%, leaving substantial failures even with that assistance.
